title.en: Were it not for, but for, as if
title.es: Si no fuera por, salvo por

es: Formar were it not for, but for, without y as if / as though con el tiempo irreal adecuado en frases sobre decisiones vitales.

teaching.en: Were it not for my mentor, I would still be unsure about my career.
teaching.es: Si no fuera por mi mentora, seguiría sin tener claro mi futuro profesional.
teaching.explanationEs: Were it not for + nombre equivale a If it weren't for: presente irreal, con would + verbo.
segments: Were it not for my mentor, I
would still be unsure about my career.
teaching.audioText: Were it not for my mentor, I would still be unsure about my career.

teaching.en: But for her encouragement, he would never have applied for the scholarship.
teaching.es: De no ser por su ánimo, nunca habría solicitado la beca.
teaching.explanationEs: But for + nombre sirve para presente o pasado; no lleva verbo propio.
segments: But for her encouragement, he would
never have applied for the scholarship.
teaching.audioText: But for her encouragement, he would never have applied for the scholarship.

teaching.en: Without a loan, I could not have paid for my studies.
teaching.es: Sin un préstamo, no habría podido pagar mis estudios.
teaching.explanationEs: Without + nombre también sustituye a if it hadn't been for; la otra cláusula marca el tiempo.
segments: Without a loan, I could not
teaching.audioText: Without a loan, I could not have paid for my studies.

teaching.en: He talks as if he were the most ambitious student in the class.
teaching.es: Habla como si fuera el estudiante más ambicioso de la clase.
teaching.explanationEs: As if / as though + were (o pasado simple) presenta algo irreal o dudoso en el presente.
segments: He talks as if he were the
most ambitious student in the class.
teaching.audioText: He talks as if he were the most ambitious student in the class.

teaching.en: He talked as if he had won the scholarship himself, but it was his sister who won it.
teaching.es: Hablaba como si él mismo hubiera ganado la beca, pero la ganó su hermana.
teaching.explanationEs: As if + had + participio presenta algo irreal referido al pasado.
segments: He talked as if he had won the scholarship
himself, but it was his sister who won it.
teaching.audioText: He talked as if he had won the scholarship himself, but it was his sister who won it.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si no fuera por mi mentora, estaría perdida.»

feedback.es: Were it not for + nombre expresa «si no fuera por» en presente y lleva would + verbo.

hint.es: Es la forma irreal de be que abre la frase.

origin.text: ___ it not for my mentor, I would be lost.

prompt.es: Elige la frase correcta para «De no ser por la beca, no habría estudiado».

choices.text: But for the scholarship, I would not have studied.
But for I had the scholarship, I would not have studied.
But for the scholarship, I will not study.

feedback.es: But for va seguido de un nombre, y la consecuencia en pasado lleva would not have + participio.

hint.es: But for no lleva verbo conjugado, y la consecuencia es pasada.

prompt.es: Completa: «Habla como si fuera un experto.»

feedback.es: Después de as if, el presente irreal usa were (o was en registro informal).

hint.es: Como si + irreal: no uses is.

origin.text: He talks as if he ___ an expert.

prompt.es: Completa: «Sin un préstamo no podría pagar» y «de no ser por tu ánimo, habría desistido».

feedback.es: Without + nombre sustituye a una condición con if, y but for + nombre expresa «de no ser por».

sentences: Without a ___, I couldn't pay for the course.
But ___ your encouragement, I would have given up.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué situación real describe el hablante.

choices.text: His brother refused to take a loan.
His brother is studying thanks to a loan.
His brother pays nothing for his studies.

feedback.es: Were it not for the loan implica que sí hay préstamo: por eso su hermano estudia y lo devuelve poco a poco.

origin.audio: Were it not for the loan, my brother would not be studying now. He is paying it back slowly.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada estructura con su uso.

pairs: Were it not for the loan

pairs.es: si no fuera por el préstamo (presente)

pairs: Had it not been for the loan

pairs.es: de no haber sido por el préstamo (pasado)
de no ser por el préstamo (presente o pasado)

feedback.es: Were it not for mira al presente, had it not been for al pasado, but for a ambos, y as if + had + participio compara con un hecho pasado irreal.

pairs: Were it not for the loan

pairs.es: si no fuera por el préstamo (presente)

pairs: Had it not been for the loan

pairs.es: de no haber sido por el préstamo (pasado)
de no ser por el préstamo (presente o pasado)

prompt.es: Completa: «Actúa como si tuviera mucho talento, pero no lo tiene.»

feedback.es: As if + pasado simple presenta algo irreal en el presente: no lo tiene, pero lo aparenta.

origin.text: She acts as if she ___ a lot of talent, but she doesn't.

prompt.es: Elige la frase correcta sobre el taller de Leo.

choices.text: Without the loan, he can't open the workshop.
Without the loan, he opened the workshop.
Without the loan, he couldn't have opened the workshop.

feedback.es: Sin préstamo (Without the loan) en pasado pide could not have + participio: no habría podido abrir el taller.

origin.text: Leo abrió su taller el año pasado gracias a un préstamo.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Sin su talento, no habría ganado la beca.»

answer.text: Without her talent she would never have won the scholarship
accepted: Without her talent she would never have won the scholarship
She would never have won the scholarship without her talent

feedback.es: Without + nombre hace de condición y la consecuencia pasada lleva would never have + participio.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hizo realmente él esa mañana.

feedback.es: As though he had… compara con algo irreal: parece cansado, pero en realidad estuvo sentado en su mesa.

origin.audio: He looks as though he had just finished a marathon. In fact, he has been sitting at his desk all morning.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que describe cómo habla tu compañero de la ciudad.

choices.text: He talks as if he didn't know the city at all.
He talks as if he knew the city well.
He talks as if he would know the city well.

feedback.es: Nunca ha estado allí, pero habla con seguridad: se comporta como si la conociera, una situación irreal que pide as if + pasado simple (knew).

origin.text: Tu compañero nunca ha estado en París, pero habla de la ciudad con mucha seguridad.

prompt.es: Completa: «De haber sabido lo del préstamo, te habría avisado.»

feedback.es: La inversión con had pide el participio: Had I known, como en el tercer condicional.

origin.text: Had I ___ about the loan, I would have told you.

prompt.es: Ordena: «De no ser por la tormenta, habríamos llegado a tiempo.»

answer.text: But for the storm we would have arrived on time
accepted: But for the storm we would have arrived on time
We would have arrived on time but for the storm

feedback.es: But for + nombre da la condición; would have + participio expresa el resultado que no ocurrió.
